notes.title: Update 2.03 Economy
notes.content:
Hello everyone. ːsteamhappyː

In this update you will find following changes

[b]New or Adjusted[/b]
[olist]
[*] New coin type: Jackpot bag 250 coins 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165672/80920aa186750520ccef65fb7c5a139feb5563bb.gif[/img]
[*] Drop rate from the treasure chest adjusted:
Coin 1                       ->[b] 65%[/b]
Coin pile 10              -> [b]20%[/b]
Chocolate Medal 25 -> [b]10%[/b]
Jackpot bag 250      ->   [b]5%[/b]
[*] Adjusted passive window look
[*] New Passive - More coins for every coin pick up
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165672/c61b8192dbde279c77622ca29417d941408a140b.png[/img]
Each upgrade of this passive will increase the coin value by 1. So if you have a coin value of 2 and you pick up a coin worth 1, you will receive 1+2 coins.

The price of the first upgrade starts at 50 coins and doubles each time.

[*] Time to beat the [b]Time Trial 1[/b] map was changed  [b]270 -> 200[/b] seconds
[*] Rewards for each map was adjusted
[/olist]

[b]Bug fix[/b]

Player on some rare occasion did not respawn after death. [b]Fixed[/b]

notes.title: Lollipop Knight Rebaked
notes.content:
Hello everyone ːsteamhappyː, 

after a long break from the Lollipop Knight project, we are finally back, and we are happy to share with you some pictures of our progress.

Lollipop Knight will undergo a complete rework. New visuals, maps, systems, enemies, pickups, achievements, health system, and much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165672/31f4f3a2a887e93a80ae0e0578f6780854f4ab56.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165672/41d56d8f1e67a64d3be0828ad92cf91664b06b64.png[/img]

A checkpoint shaped like a chocolate egg with a plastic toy inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165672/b3f46ea215eb953ad0cfb89f3a51a3f0a3af0a78.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165672/6cc57155ae487554cb85bfdfb92f37b353730ec4.png[/img]

Different types of doors that you can unlock by pulling a lever or finding a key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165672/faa8d9a55f745f65c3bb27406f745b6b231ab859.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165672/1e6602832f533b631a1dea3e3f56212a97c263d2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165672/e2dd3f1d68064e77549153db73f6208d6b779542.png[/img]

Harder maps will feature a super villain toy (1.) and his army (2.) that will try to stop you. While there will be a variety of enemy types, we can currently only showcase these two.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165672/623534e48fea18c00ba64a2f9614460016315c19.png[/img]

And the last picture shows a spoiled candy chest that comes to life. Or something ːsteamhappyː
If you smash it, it will reveal valuable loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42165672/7d0d5b510435efb87a5c64eb53976ea7263d9304.png[/img]

We are working consistently on this project, but we don't know when this update will go live on Steam. However, we will do our best to deliver it to you soon. Thank you for your support and have a nice day.ːsteamthumbsupː

[u][b]NEW[/b][/u]

Map - Dungeon Peacefull, this map is focused on training your jumping skills.

Lollipop - Red Heart acquired by finishing Dungeon Peacefull map.

Ingame stats border.

Achievement - Acquired by finishing Dungeon Peacefull map.

Level system - Level up by finishing maps. For now, there are no rewards for player levels, but we are working on it. Rewards will be added in the next updates

[u][b]Changed[/b][/u]

Score now cant drop under 0 points.

notes.title: Lollipop Knight Challenge - Community VS Game Dev
notes.content:
Greetings players.

Nowadays, it is very popular to play RPGs / FPS games. Where you need to build a certain skill to achieve a higher rank in the competitive world of online gaming.

But even so, can we really control the keyboard these days?

I created this game to see how well today's players can move in a dangerous environment where you don't know if you have solid ground under your feet.

I invite everyone to the ''community vs game dev'' challenge, and anyone who beats my score and sends me proof will be credited to the ''Worthy players of April 2022'' credits. Credits will be seen in the game forever.

So, are you worth it?

[previewyoutube=AIUEl2-Zsik;full][/previewyoutube]


Contact email: nppngames@gmail.com

-Adjusted overlapped walls
-Muffin on medium map added points 3x
